title: Tech Note: Real Numbers in 4th Dimension

historical_commentary.text: Only the teaser paragraph for this note survives, but its subject (how Reals are stored, NaN behavior, display formatting via 4D Customizer, and pitfalls of comparing real numbers) reflects a fundamental floating-point concept that is still conceptually relevant today. The specific tool used to customize display (4D Customizer Plus) and the exact real-number storage/format details of 4D 6.0 are of historical interest only.
related_updates: 4D Customizer Plus, the standalone tool for editing structure resources like number/date formats, was long ago folded into 4D's integrated Design environment
Modern 4D still uses IEEE-754-style floating point for Real fields, so the underlying NaN/comparison caveats discussed remain conceptually applicable
